facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: pressure release during cleaning and preparation on PSV-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-8210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-8210 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 3 November 2023 an incident occurred on PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during cleaning and preparation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
